definitions.explanation: A supplementary narrative that branches off from a main story, focusing on a secondary character or event. Common in manga, anime, novels, and games.
A biographical account covering aspects not included in the official or main biography. The original meaning of the word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧マンガ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外伝|がいでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A spin-off of the popular manga came out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{外伝|がいでん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脇役|わきやく}→脇役：13933_wakiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This side story depicts the past of a supporting character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本編|ほんぺん}→本編：25484_honpen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいなくて→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧{外伝|がいでん}になっている。
examples.english: It's a spin-off that can be enjoyed even without reading the main story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外伝|がいでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: To read a supplementary biography of a historical figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正史|せいし}→正史：29614_seishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{載|の}らない→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦{逸話|いつわ}→逸話：14322_itsuwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{外伝|がいでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収|おさ}められている→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: Anecdotes not found in the official history are collected in the supplementary biography.

examples.english: This supplementary biography describes a human side not visible in the official records.

notes:
USAGE:
In modern usage, sense 1 (side story/spin-off) is far more common than the original biographical meaning. Frequently appears in titles of manga, anime, light novels, and video games.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "outside" (⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧) + "biography/story" ({伝|でん}). Originally referred to biographical accounts supplementary to the official history.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外伝|がいでん}⟦シリーズ→シリーズ：10942_shiriizu⟧: spin-off series
- {外伝|がいでん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: spin-off novel
- {外伝|がいでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a side story
